 Tesla Stock: China Sales, Cybertruck Recall Threaten Turnaround 
 Licensing 
 PAOLO CONFINO 
 Updated 09:58 AM ET 05/11/2026
 Tesla (TSLA) began the week with some bad news threatening the stock's recent turnaround, as the shares dropped about 1.5% Monday morning. New data from China showed the EV maker's domestic retail sales fell 10% year over year in April, forcing the company to ship cars made at its Shanghai plant overseas.
